title: Salt Dunes: Social Diplomacy

foundation.history: A forgotten buried aqueduct once protected brine reservoirs, until recurring salt storms forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Orin Yun, a envoy, must negotiate a multilateral truce, relying on faction trust despite salt storms.
central_conflict: an opportunist alliance threatens the buried aqueduct by restricting brine reservoirs.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: salt storms destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: an opportunist alliance contests access to brine reservoirs
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
